title: Woodland Friends Christmas Clipart Set
author: TatiMockups
description:
This Woodland Friends Christmas Clipart Set features a charming collection of festive forest animals, Santa elements, cozy winter houses, holiday florals, and seasonal decorations painted in a soft watercolor style. Each illustration captures a warm and joyful winter atmosphere, perfect for greeting cards, invitations, posters, scrapbooking, branding, and festive creative projects. With gentle textures, Christmas colors, and adorable woodland characters, this bundle is ideal for adding a magical holiday touch to any design.
🌸 WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE 🌸
• 27 PNG clipart elements
• High resolution / 300dpi illustrations
• Transparent background
• Available for both commercial and personal use
🌸 HOW DO I GET MY FILES? 🌸
Etsy will send you a PDF via email with a link to a Google Drive folder where you can download all the graphics.
(Note: The PDF cannot be downloaded directly from the Etsy app.)
🌸HOW CAN I USE ? 🌸
Feel free to use these graphics for both your business and personal craft projects. This includes Print On Demand (POD) services and template-based software such as:
• Templett
• Corjl
• Canva
• JetTemplate
* or any site you need
❗️ A COMMERCIAL LICENSE DOES NOT GIVE YOU THE RIGHT TO: ❗️
• Using my images to create seamless files, patterns, or cliparts for commercial purposes
• Sharing, redistributing, or selling the images in their original format
• Using the images in a way that allows the end customer to extract them
• Selling the cliparts with or without minimal modifications and claiming them as your own
